top.title: Ataque russo em estação de trem ucraniana deixa 14 mortos; Ucrânia lança drones contra Moscou
top.summary: Rússia e Ucrânia dão início a cessar-fogo regional A Ucrânia e a Rússia trocaram ataques com drones na madrugada desta quinta-feira (29). De acordo com autoridades ucranianas, pelo menos 13 pessoas morreram em Dnipro depois que um trem foi atingido. Pouco antes, o prefeito de Moscou, Sergei Sobyanin, afirmou que 613 drones foram lançados em direção à cidade e seu entorno "entre 20h30 e 7h", mas que a maioria foi neutralizada pela defesa antiaérea. articles.title: Drone attack reportedly kills worker at Russian-occupied Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant
articles.summary: The plant has repeatedly faced threats to nuclear safety, including drone attacks, disruptions to external power supplies, and incidents affecting plant workers.

articles.title: Why did Russia agree to the Oleshky ceasefire?
articles.summary: Moscow's consent to a temporary ceasefire in Russian-occupied Oleshky seems like a long-overdue and welcome concession from a country that has repeatedly rejected or violated ceasefire proposals during the full-scale invasion of Ukraine. articles.title: At least 14 people killed in attack on Ukraine train station
articles.summary: A Russian drone strike killed at least 14 people at Dnipro’s main railway station in central Ukraine.

articles.title: Ataque com drone a estação de trens na Ucrânia deixa ao menos 14 mortos
articles.summary: Segundo empresa ferroviária estatal, drone a jato atingiu plataforma lotada na principal estação de Dnipro. Mais cinco pessoas morreram em dois outros ataques russos na Ucrânia.

articles.title: Aid mission set to enter Ukraine's Oleshky as localised ceasefire holds for third day
articles.summary: A humanitarian aid mission is set to enter the Ukrainian town of Oleshky, a Ukrainian official said on Thuirsday, as a localised truce between Kyiv and Moscow, brokered by US first lady Melania Trump, held for a third day. Some 2,000 residents in the Russian occupied city have been cut off from essential supplies amid reports that many are starving.

articles.title: While Oleshky ceasefire holds for third day, Russian attacks kill 1, injure at least 22 across Ukraine
articles.summary: Overnight, Russian forces launched 112 attack drones, 40 of the jet-powered, at Ukraine, according to the Air Force.

articles.title: Drone mata 14 em estação de trem na Ucrânia; Kiev faz maior ataque à Rússia
articles.summary: Um drone russo matou ao menos 13 pessoas nesta quinta-feira (29) numa plataforma de trem em Dnipro, no centro da Ucrânia . Na via inversa, Kiev promoveu na madrugada o maior ataque com aviões-robôs contra o país de Vladimir Putin , que invadiu o vizinho em 2022.

articles.title: At least 13 killed in 'horrific' Russian drone strike at Ukraine train station
articles.summary: At least 13 people were killed when a Russian drone struck a busy railway station in Ukraine's Dnipro on Thursday, President Volodymyr Zelensky said, describing the attack as "horrific" and urging Kyiv's allies not to ease sanctions on Moscow.
